title: llama.cpp backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the llama-cpp provider (Phase 12). x-flag names the llama-server CLI flag; command.py remains the executable mapping. Fields not yet passed to llama-server carry x-supported: false (documented, disabled in the UI).

artifacts.title: Model files
artifacts.description: GGUF artifacts resolved by provider_lib.downloader.ensure_artifact before the server spawns.

model.title: Main model
model.description: Primary GGUF model file (hf-file descriptor or local path).

mmproj.title: Vision projector
mmproj.description: mmproj GGUF for multimodal models; omit for text-only.

draft.title: Draft model
draft.description: Draft GGUF for speculative decoding (--spec-type draft-dflash).

ctx.title: Context size
ctx.description: Prompt context window in tokens. Canonical; the legacy top-level synonym 'context_size' is still accepted by the driver.

keep.title: Keep tokens
keep.description: Number of initial tokens to always keep in context.

rope_freq_base.title: RoPE frequency base
rope_freq_base.description: Overrides the value taken from the model.

rope_freq_scale.title: RoPE frequency scale
rope_freq_scale.description: Overrides the value taken from the model.

yarn_orig_ctx.title: YaRN original context
yarn_orig_ctx.description: Original context length for YaRN scaling (0 = use ctx).

yarn_ext_factor.title: YaRN ext factor
yarn_ext_factor.description: YaRN extrapolation mix factor (-1 = compute from scaling).

yarn_attn_factor.title: YaRN attn factor
yarn_attn_factor.description: YaRN scale sqrt(t) for attention logits.

yarn_beta_slow.title: YaRN beta slow
yarn_beta_slow.description: YaRN tangent scale factor for low frequencies.

yarn_beta_fast.title: YaRN beta fast
yarn_beta_fast.description: YaRN tangent scale factor for high frequencies.

cache_prompt.title: Cache prompt
cache_prompt.description: Keep the prompt in the KV cache (--cache-prompt / --no-cache-prompt). NOT the obsolete --prompt-cache.

cache_reuse.title: Cache reuse depth
cache_reuse.description: Reuse KV cache for prompts differing in the last N tokens.

cache_type_k.title: K cache quantization
cache_type_k.description: Data type for the K (key) KV cache.

cache_type_v.title: V cache quantization
cache_type_v.description: Data type for the V (value) KV cache.

kv_offload.title: KV offload
kv_offload.description: Offload the KV cache to CPU / RAM.

kv_unified.title: Unified KV cache
kv_unified.description: Single KV cache shared across slots.

kv_unified_per_slot.title: Unified KV per slot
kv_unified_per_slot.description: Per-slot budget for the unified cache.

ctx_checkpoints.title: Context checkpoints
ctx_checkpoints.description: Number of context checkpoints kept for fast seek.

checkpoint_min_step.title: Checkpoint min step
checkpoint_min_step.description: Minimum token step between KV checkpoints. Canonical name for the legacy 'checkpoint_every' key (still accepted by the driver).

cache_ram.title: RAM cache (MiB)
cache_ram.description: Max MiB of offline KV cache kept in RAM.

cache_idle_slots.title: Cache idle slots
cache_idle_slots.description: Keep idle slots' KV cache in RAM (--cache-idle-slots / --no-cache-idle-slots). Canonical name for the legacy inverted 'no_cache_idle_slots' key (still accepted by the driver).

swa_full.title: SWA full cache
swa_full.description: Use full-size (not SWA-trimmed) KV cache for sliding-window attention models.

load_mode.title: Load mode
load_mode.description: Model loading mode; 'auto' leaves the server default (replaces the removed --mmap/--no-mmap flags).

lazy_mode.title: Lazy load
lazy_mode.description: Load tensors lazily on first use.

repack.title: Repack tensors
repack.description: Repack tensor layout during load when beneficial.

no_host.title: No host tensors
no_host.description: Fail instead of keeping tensors on the host when VRAM is short.

gpu_layers.title: GPU layers
gpu_layers.description: Layers to store in VRAM. Upstream default is 'auto' (fit as many as possible), not a fixed count.

device.title: Device
device.description: Compute device(s), e.g. 'CUDA0' or a comma list.

split_mode.title: Split mode
split_mode.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs.

main_gpu.title: Main GPU
main_gpu.description: Device index used for compute not offloaded.

fit.title: Memory fit
fit.description: Automatically fit the model to available VRAM.

fit_target.title: Fit target
fit_target.description: Target free-memory margins per device (MiB list).

fit_ctx.title: Fit context
fit_ctx.description: Context size assumed when fitting the KV cache to VRAM.

override_tensor.title: Override tensor
override_tensor.description: Force specific tensors on/off device (advanced syntax).

cpu_moe.title: CPU MoE experts
cpu_moe.description: Run MoE expert weights on CPU.

n_cpu_moe.title: N CPU MoE layers
n_cpu_moe.description: Number of leading MoE layers to keep on CPU.

n_cpu_ffn.title: N CPU FFN layers
n_cpu_ffn.description: Number of leading FFN layers to keep on CPU.

op_offload.title: Op offload
op_offload.description: Offload individual ops to CPU when VRAM is tight.

spec_type.title: Speculative type
spec_type.description: Speculative decoding mode. The driver honors 'draft-mtp' explicitly (n-max from mtp_draft_max or spec_draft_n_max); a draft artifact still forces 'draft-dflash'. Other modes are not yet wired (x-supported: false semantics: documented only).

spec_draft_n_max.title: Draft tokens max
spec_draft_n_max.description: Max speculated tokens per step. Used with the draft-mtp path when mtp_draft_max is absent.

mtp_draft_max.title: MTP draft max (legacy alias)
mtp_draft_max.description: Legacy alias: >0 enables --spec-type draft-mtp with this n-max. Superseded by spec_type + spec_draft_n_max; still honored by the driver.

spec_draft_p_split.title: Draft split probability
spec_draft_p_split.description: Probability threshold controlling draft tree branching.

spec_draft_p_min.title: Draft min probability
spec_draft_p_min.description: Minimum token probability to continue drafting.

spec_draft_ngl.title: Draft GPU layers
spec_draft_ngl.description: Layers of the draft model to offload to GPU.

spec_draft_device.title: Draft device
spec_draft_device.description: Compute device for the draft model.

spec_draft_cache_type_k.title: Draft K cache type
spec_draft_cache_type_k.description: Quantization of the draft model's K cache.

spec_draft_cache_type_v.title: Draft V cache type
spec_draft_cache_type_v.description: Quantization of the draft model's V cache.

spec_draft_backend_sampling.title: Draft backend sampling
spec_draft_backend_sampling.description: Sample draft tokens on the backend device.

min_p.title: Min-p
min_p.description: Minimum probability cutoff relative to the top token.

xtc_probability.title: XTC probability
xtc_probability.description: Probability of applying the XTC sampler.

repeat_last_n.title: Repeat last n
repeat_last_n.description: Look-back window for the repetition penalty.

dry_sequence_breaker.title: DRY sequence breaker
dry_sequence_breaker.description: String that breaks DRY sequence matching.

adaptive_target.title: Adaptive target
adaptive_target.description: Target entropy for adaptive sampling (0 = disabled).

backend_sampling.title: Backend sampling
backend_sampling.description: Run sampling on the inference backend device.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Named effort level for reasoning models.

reasoning_budget_message.title: Reasoning budget message
reasoning_budget_message.description: Message emitted when the reasoning budget is exhausted.

reasoning_preserve.title: Preserve reasoning
reasoning_preserve.description: Keep reasoning content in history across turns.

reasoning_format.title: Reasoning format
reasoning_format.description: Reasoning tag format for models without a native template.

jinja.title: Jinja template
jinja.description: Use the embedded Jinja chat template.

chat_template_file.title: Chat template file
chat_template_file.description: Path to a chat template file.

chat_template_kwargs.title: Chat template kwargs
chat_template_kwargs.description: JSON object of extra chat-template variables.

mmproj_offload.title: mmproj offload
mmproj_offload.description: Offload the vision projector to GPU.

mmproj_device.title: mmproj device
mmproj_device.description: Compute device for the vision projector.

mtmd_batch_max_tokens.title: MTMD batch max tokens
mtmd_batch_max_tokens.description: Max vision tokens batched per pass.

video_fps.title: Video FPS
video_fps.description: Frames per second sampled from video input.

backend_port.title: Backend port
backend_port.description: llama-server listen port. Relocated here from the old top-level 'backend_port'; when absent the driver uses PROVIDER_PORT + 1 from the container env (no schema default).

threads_batch.title: Batch threads
threads_batch.description: CPU threads for prompt batch (-1 = same as threads).

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: Logical batch size for prompt processing.

warmup.title: Warmup
warmup.description: Warm up the model at startup.

context_shift.title: Context shift
context_shift.description: Shift the context instead of erroring on overflow.

flash_attn.title: Flash attention
flash_attn.description: Tri-state flash attention (upstream default 'auto'). The driver normalizes booleans to on/off and passes 'auto' through.

pooling.title: Pooling type
pooling.description: Pooling type for embeddings (--pooling). null/absent leaves the llama-server default; only meaningful when the backend serves the embedding modality.

sleep_idle_seconds.title: Sleep idle seconds
sleep_idle_seconds.description: Backend sleep after idle (-1 = never). Matrix idle reaping is admin-driven, so this is usually left off.

slot_prompt_similarity.title: Slot prompt similarity
slot_prompt_similarity.description: Similarity threshold for routing a prompt to a warm slot.

cpu_mask_batch.title: CPU mask (batch)
cpu_mask_batch.description: Hex CPU affinity mask for batch processing.

cpu_range_batch.title: CPU range (batch)
cpu_range_batch.description: CPU id range for batch threads.

cpu_strict_batch.title: CPU strict (batch)
cpu_strict_batch.description: Strictly enforce the batch CPU mask.

host.title: Listen host
host.description: llama-server bind address. The provider proxies it; loopback is the safe default on the LAN.

sse_ping_interval.title: SSE ping interval (s)
sse_ping_interval.description: Keep-alive ping interval for SSE streams.

threads_http.title: HTTP threads
threads_http.description: Threads serving the HTTP layer (-1 = auto).

props.title: Props endpoint
props.description: Expose /props and allow runtime property updates.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Shared secret required on inbound llama-server requests.

api_prefix.title: API prefix
api_prefix.description: Path prefix for the OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

log_jsonl.title: JSONL logs
log_jsonl.description: Emit log lines as JSON objects.
